table.name: nuclear_power_plants
table.purpose: One row per nuclear power reactor unit worldwide, with location, status, reactor type, lifecycle dates, capacity, and data provenance. Appears to be derived from a public reactor database (e.g. IAEA PRIS / World Nuclear Association).

col_001.name: reactor_id
col_001.description: Primary key; a numeric identifier for each reactor unit (unique across all 788 rows).

col_002.name: reactor_name
col_002.description: Name of the reactor unit, typically plant name plus unit number, e.g. 'Hope Creek-1', 'Shin-Kori-4'. Unique per row.

col_003.name: latitude
col_003.description: Latitude of the plant site in decimal degrees (range consistent with -90..90; e.g. 39.467 for Hope Creek). Empty for 41 rows.

col_004.name: longitude
col_004.description: Longitude of the plant site in decimal degrees, negative west of Greenwich (e.g. -75.535 for Hope Creek). Empty for 41 rows.

col_005.name: country
col_005.description: Country where the reactor is located (40 distinct values, e.g. United States, France, Japan).

col_006.name: status
col_006.description: Lifecycle status of the unit: Operational, Shutdown, Planned, Under Construction, Suspended/Cancelled Construction.

col_007.name: reactor_type
col_007.description: Reactor type code: PWR, BWR, PHWR, GCR (gas-cooled), LWGR (RBMK), FBR (fast breeder), HWLWR, HWGCR, HTGR, etc. Empty for some planned units.

col_008.name: reactor_model
col_008.description: Specific reactor design/model, e.g. 'BWR-4 (Mark 1)', 'APR-1400', 'VVER V-320', 'MAGNOX', 'CANDU 200'. Empty for 114 rows.

col_009.name: construction_start_date
col_009.description: Date construction began (ISO date). Empty for 94 rows (planned units not yet started). Some values are approximate (e.g. '1970-01-01').

col_010.name: first_criticality_or_grid_connection_date
col_010.description: Date the unit achieved first criticality or was connected to the grid. Empty for 168 rows (not yet built). Could alternatively be commercial-operation date; the exact milestone is tentative.

col_011.name: shutdown_date
col_011.description: Date the unit was permanently shut down; empty for 615 rows (units still operating or never built). Sample values include 1979-03-28 (Three Mile Island) and 2011-08-06.

col_012.name: capacity_mw
col_012.description: Net (or gross) electrical capacity in megawatts; e.g. 1067 for Hope Creek, 1340 for Shin-Kori-4, 18 for the KNK-II prototype. Empty for 90 rows.

col_013.name: last_updated
col_013.description: Timestamp when the record was last updated (ISO 8601 with timezone offset). Many records share bulk-update timestamps (e.g. 2015-05-24T04:51:xx+03:00), indicating batch edits.

col_014.name: source
col_014.description: Data provenance: which references the row's data came from — WNA (World Nuclear Association), IAEA, wikipedia, or combinations.
